label: Heading
description: A read-only heading inside a column, tab, or card, either with fixed text ("Customer impact") or bound to a field so it shows that field's value (typically the record's title). Use it to introduce a group of loose elements or to show a record value as a title; use card and section titles for ordinary grouping.
usage: Bind to the title field (field: title) when a column needs the record's name as a heading.
Use fixed text for short labels that introduce a group of elements without a card.
Prefer levels 2–4; level 1 is normally the page or record title.
constraints: Exactly one of text or field must be set.
field must be a key of the view's entity; if the viewer cannot read it, the heading is not rendered.
text is at most 120 characters; level is 1–4 (default 2).

field.description: Field whose display value is the heading text.

binding.description: Optional read-only binding to one field's display value.

accessibility.notes: aria-level equals level; the visual size follows the level, so the outline and the look always agree.

responsive: Wraps onto several lines; never truncated.

examples.description: Ticket title as a level-2 heading
